title: JAGER Observability Event
description: Minimal structured event emitted along the JAGER enforcement path (Agent Runtime Interface -> Capability Manager -> Policy Engine -> Information-Flow Controller -> Resource Governor -> Adapter -> Provenance Engine). This schema is consumed by the observability viewer only; it does not itself make security decisions (see SRS Section 10.2, 5.1).

timestamp.description: UTC ISO-8601 timestamp of when the enforcement path recorded this event.

event_type.description: Category of event. 'security_decision' covers the Policy Engine / Resource Governor outcome. Future components may emit other types (e.g. 'lifecycle', 'budget_update').

trace_id.description: Unique identifier for the protected operation, per NFR-04. Must be linkable end-to-end from agent request to adapter execution to result.

parent_trace_id.description: Optional trace ID of a causally-related parent operation (e.g. a child-agent spawn or a multi-step request).

agent_id.description: Identity of the requesting agent, per FR-01 agent registration.

operation.description: The verb/operation requested, e.g. READ, AGGREGATE, EXPORT, WRITE, SPAWN.

resource.description: The resource or resource pattern the operation targets, e.g. a dataset, field, or tool name.

decision.description: Outcome of policy/resource evaluation, per Section 10.2 of the SRS.

reason.description: Human-readable explanation of the decision, per FR-21 / NFR-08.

policy_version.description: Version of the policy definition that produced this decision, per SR-09.

capability.description: The capability string checked for this request, e.g. READ:sales.

data_classification.description: Classification of the resource involved, per FR-07.

latency_ms.description: Enforcement-path latency for this decision in milliseconds, excluding downstream adapter execution time (NFR-01, NFR-02).

component.description: The JAGER component that emitted this event, e.g. policy_engine, resource_governor, exasol_adapter.

metadata.description: Free-form additional context (e.g. row counts, budget remaining). Not relied upon by the viewer's core display.
